canada.title: Online gambling more than doubles among young Montreal men, study finds
canada.summary: A new study finds online gambling has more than doubled among young Montreal men, as treatment providers report more young people seeking help.

canada.title: They thought they buried their brother in the family plot; it was a stranger instead
canada.summary: When two sisters from Springdale, N.L., made arrangements to bury their brother, they weren’t prepared for the ordeal ahead. Now, a year later, they’re hoping by sharing their story, it will lead to changes in how cremations are handled in the province.

canada.title: Grand Falls-Windsor mayor says he's open to a data centre coming to town — done right
canada.summary: Mayor Mike Browne says he’s open to hearing data centre proposals for his community, as they'd bring in economic benefits. But he says they have to be done with public consultation and be properly assessed.

canada.title: Worst of beef price hikes may be over, but don’t expect cheaper steak anytime soon
canada.summary: Beef prices are at record highs. But there is some good news for Canadians who enjoy a good steak. Beef prices have stabilized, but experts say that doesn't mean grocery prices will be dropping anytime soon.

canada.title: Hidden cameras reveal accessibility barriers at leading restaurants
canada.summary: Malfunctioning power door operators, inaccessible self-service kiosks and the inability to get a braille menu were among the issues people with disabilities faced while eating out as part of a Marketplace investigation into accessibility at fast-food and full-service restaurants in Ontario.

canada.title: Gatineau athlete drafted by the San Antonio Spurs' farm team
canada.summary: Justin Ndjock-Tadjoré was drafted by the Austin Spurs, the San Antonio Spurs' affiliate team, on Oct. 24.

canada.title: A mysterious U.S. army barrel washed ashore in Quebec. Why did it drum up anthrax concerns?
canada.summary: Quebec provincial police have confirmed that a barrel discovered on an uninhabited island in the St-Lawrence River does not contain active anthrax — ruling out the most dangerous possibility in an ongoing mystery.

canada.title: Federal budget pledges $1B to find housing for 2,000 homeless in Winnipeg
canada.summary: The federal government has promised more than $1 billion in funding to "break the cycle of homelessness" and find housing for 2,000 people who currently live without in Winnipeg.

canada.title: 15 patients released, 5 still hospitalized following bus crash near Mackenzie, B.C.
canada.summary: WorkSafeBC and RCMP are still investigating what police described as a "chaotic scene" when the shuttle bus went off Highway 39, causing hospitals in Prince George and Mackenzie to declare a code orange.

canada.title: B.C. teen who moved schools for volleyball denied competitive play by transfer bylaw
canada.summary: A 16-year-old B.C. teen who moved from Hudson's Hope to Fort St. John to attend a school with a senior girls volleyball team won't be allowed to play this year because of a longstanding bylaw on athlete transfers.
